rules.text:
per claim per side: paired over seeds (treatment arm vs control, same side). OK = sign matches direction AND z in the direction >= 3 AND |rel| >= 5 %. ganksOwnPerMin is defined (0 allowed) whenever the phase lasted >= 60 s in the match; valid pairs < 200 on either side => unmeasurable (no fallback registered). Guard: ganksPerMin.

(team total) of the same side must not fall (z <= -3 AND |rel| >= 5 % on either side => guard_failed); a guard with < 200 valid pairs on either side makes the option unmeasurable. A strong-side option needs BOTH phase claims and BOTH guards on BOTH sides. Red/blue symmetry = both sides must pass (one side alone stays design) plus the control symmetry check below. Precedence: unmeasurable > reversed > guard_failed > confirmed > one_sided > insufficient. Same thresholds and precedence as the approved C5 registration; only the claim metric changed (share -> focus-lane count, per Owner).

flags: SIDE_ASYMMETRY (|z| >= 3): focusMidEarly ganksOwnPerMin.mid.early blue−red 0.017 z 3.42, strongSideMid ganksOwnPerMin.mid.early blue−red 0.017 z 3.42 — document before any promotion

OWNER_DECISION: confirmed focusTopEarly, focusMidEarly, focusBotEarly, focusTopMid, focusMidMid, focusBotMid, focusTopLate, focusMidLate, focusBotLate, strongSideTop, strongSideMid, strongSideBot — promotion to live follows the Registry/truth-table rules, Owner decides
